findings.title: Refund of a PENDING_COUNTER kiosk order via change-payment-status route permanently leaks decremented stock (refund cascade bypassed)
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. PaymentStateMachine.php:13-16 allows PENDING_COUNTER=>[PAID,REFUNDED]. OrderService::changePaymentStatus:2266-2315 sets payment_status, writes ActionLog+AuditLog, dispatches ONLY OrderPaymentStatusChanged (2310-2314); orders.status left UNCHANGED. EventServiceProvider.php:180-182 OrderPaymentStatusChanged listener list = [PersistOrderPaymentStatusChangedToOutbox] ONLY — no stock/loyalty release. Stock release is keyed exclusively to OrderCanceled (EventServiceProvider:185-188 ReleaseStockOnOrderCanceled) and RefundCreated (197-211 ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated + ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund); changePaymentStatus dispatches NEITHER. Reachability confirmed: Order.php:19 and FrontendOrder.php:19 BOTH map protected $table='orders', so OnlineOrderController::changePaymentStatus(Order $order) route-model binding (routes/api.php:983) resolves a kiosk FrontendOrder row. PaymentStatusRequest.php:19 authorizes Admin/Branch Manager/POS Operator; REFUNDED is whitelisted (PaymentStatusRequest.php:37). Kiosk-cash precondition confirmed: FrontendOrderService.php:266-267 sets PENDING_COUNTER, :578-580 auto-accepts PENDING->ACCEPT, :237/:594-595 dispatch OrderCreated for counter-deferred cash -> DecrementStockOnOrderCreated (EventServiceProvider:173) decrements stock unconditionally (DecrementStockOnOrderCreated.php:35, no payment gate). NO self-heal: CleanupStalePendingKioskOrders.php:36-37 purges only status=PENDING AND payment_status IN {UNPAID,PENDING_COUNTER}; a status>=ACCEPT, payment=REFUNDED order matches neither. NO covering test: tests/Feature/Order/ChangePaymentStatusOutboxTest.php does not mention REFUNDED/stock; tests/Feature/Refund/RefundListenerFailureIsolationTest.php triggers via RefundCreated::dispatch directly (L104/L156), not via changePaymentStatus.
findings.recommendation: Either (a) in changePaymentStatus, when target==REFUNDED and old==PENDING_COUNTER, route through the refund cascade (dispatch RefundCreated or call PaymentService::cancelCounterPayment which sets status=CANCELED alongside REFUNDED AND fires RefundCreated -> ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated + ClawbackLoyaltyPointsOnRefund), or (b) remove PENDING_COUNTER->REFUNDED from PaymentStateMachine::TRANSITIONS and force all refunds through cancelCounterPayment / refund-with-counter-entry. Add a sentinel asserting REFUNDED via change-payment-status releases stock. NOTE: this is DISTINCT from the already-known backlog P1 (changePaymentStatus PENDING_COUNTER->PAID skips fiscal_seq alloc) — confirmed separate: PaymentService::confirmCounterPayment DOES allocate fiscal_sequence_no at PaymentService.php:321-322, so the PAID-path fiscal gap only applies to the change-payment-status route, not the counter-collect flow.

findings.line: 96-108 (active query, no payment filter) + 51/132-153 (deleted_ids) vs app/Services/KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:74-82 (/list WITH payment filter)
findings.title: KDS /sync active-orders query omits the payment_status filter that /list enforces, and deleted_ids never emits a REFUNDED-while-active order — /sync and /list disagree on the same order
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:74-82 (/list): whereIn('status',KitchenReleaseRule::visibleStatuses()) AND (payment_status=PAID OR PENDING_COUNTER OR (order_type=POS AND pos_payment_method=CASH)). KdsSyncService.php:96-108 (/sync): Order::with(...)->whereIn('status',$activeStatuses=[ACCEPT,PREPARING,PREPARED] (L50)) ->where('updated_at','>=',...) — NO payment_status predicate. KdsSyncService deleted_ids (L132-153) emits only soft-deleted (onlyTrashed L135) + leftWindow whereIn('status',$inactiveStatuses=[DELIVERED,CANCELED,REJECTED] L51) — REFUNDED-while-active absent. Effect: the order from the P2 finding above (status=PREPARING, payment_status=REFUNDED, kiosk) is EXCLUDED by /list (fails payment gate) but INCLUDED by /sync active set, and never reported in deleted_ids. Production board self-heals because KitchenDisplaySystemComponent.vue:1527-1532 sync handler triggers _debouncedRefresh -> authoritative /list removal; a sync-delta-only consumer would keep a stale card.
findings.recommendation: Mirror the /list payment_status predicate into KdsSyncService::sync active query, and either add REFUNDED-while-active to the deleted_ids emission or drop such orders from the active set, so the delta feed is consistent with the authoritative list. Add a sentinel comparing the row-set of /list and /sync over a payment_status matrix including REFUNDED. Note: fixing the P2 root cause (refund moves order out of the active window) would also close this divergence.

findings.line: 74-82 (KDS /list explicit payment gate) vs app/Services/OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:59-63 (OSS status-as-proxy, no payment predicate)
findings.title: KDS and OSS encode the same 'order is released' invariant via two independent mechanisms — KDS uses an explicit payment_status allowlist, OSS relies on status in [PREPARING,PREPARED] as a proxy; they agree today only by coincidence of the V1 state graph
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. KDS /list KitchenDisplaySystemOrderService.php:75-82 filters payment_status IN {PAID,PENDING_COUNTER} OR (POS+CASH) — explicit payment gate. OSS OrderStatusScreenOrderService.php:59-63 filters whereIn('order_type',[KIOSK,TAKEAWAY]) + whereIn('status',[PREPARING,PREPARED]) with NO payment_status predicate. Harmless today because the only unpaid order reaching PREPARING+ is the intended PENDING_COUNTER kiosk-cash case (card/TR stay UNPAID at PENDING, never bumped). But the same 'don't show unpaid orders' invariant is enforced by two unrelated mechanisms. Concrete divergence: a REFUNDED-while-active order (see P2 finding) is HIDDEN by KDS (fails payment gate) but still DISPLAYED to the customer by OSS (passes status proxy) — the two surfaces disagree on the same order.
findings.recommendation: Route both KDS and OSS visibility through one shared domain predicate (KitchenReleaseRule::orderIsReleased / isReleasedToKitchen, already the live SSOT). Have OSS add the same payment-status gate (or call the shared rule) so 'released to customer wall' and 'released to kitchen' derive from ONE definition instead of two hand-maintained filters that currently agree only by coincidence.

findings.title: Stock decrement dispatched twice per order (inline + OrderCreated listener) with divergent failure semantics; dedup hinges on a single seed-exclusion line
findings.grep_evidence: VERIFIED at HEAD. Inline: OrderService.php:989 decrementForOrder($this->order,$idempotencyKey) inside the order tx; FrontendOrderService.php:512 decrementForOrder($this->frontendOrder,$idempotencyKey). After-commit listener: DecrementStockOnOrderCreated.php:35 decrementForOrder($event->order) with NO seed. decrementForOrder (StockService.php:27-29) -> mutateForOrder reason='order_created'. movementKey() (StockService.php:327-344) builds key from [reason,class,id,line_uid,stockable_type,stockable_id] and appends seed ONLY when reason !== 'order_created' (L337). So inline(seed) and listener(no-seed) compute the SAME key for order_created -> the second insert is skipped by StockMovement::where('idempotency_key',$movementKey)->exists() (L102). Failure-policy divergence CONFIRMED: inline path throws StockUnavailableException (L111-113) inside the order tx -> whole order rolls back (order rejected); listener path is failure-ISOLATED (DecrementStockOnOrderCreated.php:36-61 log + StockDecrementFailedEvent + swallow, with an explicit comment block L13-31 documenting the intentional isolation). The no-double-decrement guarantee depends entirely on the L337 seed-exclusion: any future change re-including the seed for order_created, or any path that dispatches OrderCreated WITHOUT a prior inline decrement, silently double-decrements.
findings.recommendation: Pick ONE authoritative decrement path. Either make DecrementStockOnOrderCreated the single owner and remove the inline OrderService:989 / FrontendOrderService:512 calls (uniform isolated failure policy — but stock-shortage would no longer block order creation, a product decision), or keep inline authoritative and unregister/no-op the listener for surfaces that already decrement inline. At minimum add a sentinel asserting movementKey() drops the seed for reason==='order_created' so the dedup invariant cannot silently regress.

summary: Read-only intersections+dedup deep-dive at HEAD 8db38d801, every anchor grep/Read-verified. ONE genuinely NEW P2 with full reproduction: a refund of a PENDING_COUNTER kiosk order via the change-payment-status route (PaymentStateMachine allows PENDING_COUNTER->REFUNDED) sets payment_status=REFUNDED, leaves orders.status untouched, and dispatches ONLY OrderPaymentStatusChanged whose sole listener is the outbox persister — neither OrderCanceled nor RefundCreated fires, so ReleaseStockOnRefundCreated never runs and the decremented stock_levels are leaked permanently, with no Cleanup self-heal. This sits at the Refund x Stock x KDS x OSS intersection: the same REFUNDED-while-active order then exposes two latent cross-surface divergences (KDS /sync omits the payment filter that /list enforces and never emits the order in deleted_ids; OSS shows it to the customer via status-as-proxy while KDS hides it via its explicit payment gate). A second NEW P2 is the dual stock-decrement design (inline-throws-and-blocks vs listener-isolated) deduped only by a single seed-exclusion line. The KitchenReleaseRule vs OrderStateMachine byte-identical copy is confirmed but refined: the OrderStateMachine copy is DEAD (zero callers) so it is dead-code/SSOT hardening, not a live disagreement (is_new=false, known backlog). Dropped 2 raw items (counter-collect endpoint anchor false alarm, and a bundle of already-known/dead-branch non-issues) per the task baseline. None block ship for V1 LOCAL single-box, but the P2 refund-stock-leak is the highest-value new finding and warrants a sentinel + cascade-routing fix. NO new P0/P1 — consistent with the 0-P0 baseline.
